# Publish Runbook

Turns tribal knowledge into a runbook an unfamiliar responder can follow
at three in the morning.

## Shape

- One trigger, stated first.
- Numbered steps, each carrying the exact command.
- A stop condition and an escalation path.

Prose explaining the architecture belongs in a design doc, not here.
[The template](templates/runbook.md) has the headings, [the review
checklist](docs/runbook-review.md) has the bar, and [the index](docs/runbook-index.md)
lists what already exists.
